sprintName: Kahoot-Hybrid Quiz Maker Studio & Execution Engine
goals: Build quiz studio with 10–20 minute timer constraint
Support manual quiz creation, JSON/CSV upload, and automated question extraction from lecture documents
Student interactive quiz taking experience with 75% passing mark and immediate MongoDB persistence
Integrate anti-tampering integrity monitoring and direct module-to-quiz prerequisite unlocking

issues.title: [Quiz Maker] Quiz Studio with 10–20 Minute Configurable Countdown Timer
issues.description: Enforce quiz time limits strictly between 10 minutes minimum and 20 minutes maximum in both quiz creation studio and runtime countdown timer.

issues.title: [Quiz Maker] Multi-Mode Quiz Creation (Manual, JSON/CSV Upload, and Text/File Extraction)
issues.description: Support interactive question builder, bulk JSON/CSV quiz file uploads, and auto-generation of quiz questions from uploaded lecture materials/text.

issues.title: [Quiz Engine] Student Interactive Quiz Taker with 75% Passing Threshold Enforcement & Database Upload
issues.description: Deliver interactive quiz taker inspired by Kahoot-style interface, enforcing the mandatory 75% passing mark to mark module completion, and instantly saving submissions to MongoDB Atlas.

issues.title: [Quiz Maker] Automated Question Generator & NLP Extractor from Uploaded Lecture Notes, Slides, and Text
issues.description: Implement heuristic parser and question generator that analyzes uploaded lecture documents (PDF/presentation/text) to automatically extract core definitions and concepts into multiple-choice quiz questions with distractors and explanations.

issues.title: [Quiz Maker] Question Bank Import Validator (JSON/CSV/Aiken formats) with Format Linting & Schema Enforcement
issues.description: Provide a robust file import pipeline for question banks supporting JSON and CSV formats with schema validation, answer key verification, question randomization, and inline error highlighting.

issues.title: [Quiz Engine] Anti-Tampering & Academic Integrity Monitor (Tab Blur Detection & Single-Session Timer)
issues.description: Implement academic integrity safeguards during active quiz sessions: browser tab-switch/window blur detection warning counter, single-session token locks to prevent concurrent attempts, and automatic submission upon timer expiry.

issues.title: [Curriculum] Module-to-Quiz Direct Binding, Retake Practice Intervals & Dynamic Prerequisite Unlock Trigger
issues.description: Create explicit database relationships binding topics/modules to designated end quizzes. Automatically trigger sequential module unlocks when student scores >= 75%, and enforce mandatory review intervals if student fails to reach passing mark.
